jp_verse: 絶えぬ雫が　白い結晶を育て\n\n    谷の静けさに　光を集める
en_verse: Endless droplets nurtured white crystals,\ngathering light within the valley's stillness.

jp_verse:
岩は静かに

    砕けた姿を残し

    森の沈黙だけが

    長い時を語っていた
en_verse: The rock remained in its shattered form,\nand only the forest's silence\nspoke of the long years that had passed.

jp_verse: 砂時計の中で　一粒ずつ\n\n    静かに落ちる砂が　時を数えている
en_verse: Inside the hourglass, one grain at a time,\nquietly falling sand counted the passing hours.

jp_verse: 朝の光は　あの花ばかり照らし\n\n    隣の枝は　黙って揺れていた
en_verse: The morning light shone only upon that one flower,\nwhile the neighboring branch swayed in silence.

jp_verse: 削られた田に　水が満ち\n\n    朝の光が　まっすぐに伸びてゆく
en_verse: The carved rice fields filled slowly with water,\nand the morning light stretched in perfect lines.

jp_verse: 森の奥へ　光が降り\n\n    静かな流れに　金を宿していた
en_verse: A beam of light descended through the forest,\nleaving gold upon the silent stream.

jp_verse: 熟れた実が　枝をたわませ\n\n    陽だまりの重みが　秋を知らせる
en_verse: Heavy fruit bent the branches low,\nand the warmth of sunlight announced the autumn season.

jp_verse: 土の器に　湯気が立ち\n\n    手の温もりが　形を残している
en_verse: Steam rose gently from the earthen bowl,\nwhile the warmth of hands remained in its shape.

jp_verse: 古い路地裏に　匂いが満ち\n\n    夕暮れの犬が　静かに鼻を寄せた
en_verse: An old alley filled with heavy odor,\nas a stray dog quietly leaned in to smell the dusk.

jp_verse: 落ち葉の道を　鼻先で探り\n\n    小さな気配を　風から拾っている
en_verse: Along the fallen leaves, a nose searched softly,\ngathering tiny traces carried by the wind.

jp_verse: 蓮の花びらに　朝露が宿り\n\n    言葉にならぬ美が　水面に揺れていた
en_verse: Morning dew rested upon the lotus petals,\nand a beauty beyond words trembled on the water's surface.

jp_verse: 積まれた書類を　一枚ずつめくり\n\n    静かな机から　国の道が決まる
en_verse: Turning the stacked documents one sheet at a time,\nfrom a quiet desk the nation's path was decided.

jp_verse: 深く張る根が　森を支え\n\n    長い年月が　幹に重なってゆく
en_verse: Deep roots upheld the ancient forest,\nwhile long years gathered within the trunk.

jp_verse: 霧の岩山に　穴が開き\n\n    誰も知らない風が　そこを通り抜ける
en_verse: In the misty cliffs, a hollow opened in stone,\nand an unknown wind passed silently through it.

jp_verse: 山の川が　石を越え\n\n    絶えぬ音だけが　谷に響いていた
en_verse: The mountain river crossed over stones,\nits endless voice echoing through the valley.

jp_verse: 幾つもの流れが　谷を巡り\n\n    広い大地に　人の暮らしを結んでいる
en_verse: Many rivers wandered across the plains,\nbinding together the lives of distant people.

jp_verse: 流れに従う舟は　静かに進み\n\n    夕陽だけが　水面を照らしていた
en_verse: The small boat followed the flowing current,\nwhile only the sunset watched upon the water.

jp_verse: 水は形なく　橋も空も包み\n\n    朝の光だけが　波紋に遊んでいた
en_verse: Formless, water embraced both bridge and sky,\nwhile only the morning light played upon the ripples.

jp_verse: 水は動きを止め　透き通る氷となり\n\n    軒の下で　冬を守っていた
en_verse: Water stilled its motion, becoming transparent ice,\nguarding winter beneath the eaves.

jp_verse: 一滴の水が　石の鉢に落ち\n\n    広がる波紋だけが　永を語っていた
en_verse: A single drop of water fell into the stone basin,\nand only the spreading ripples spoke of eternity.
